places.name: The British Library
places.connection: Houses the original manuscript of Alice's Adventures in Wonderland, handwritten and illustrated by Lewis Carroll.

places.name: Christ Church, Oxford
places.connection: Lewis Carroll (Charles Dodgson) was a mathematics lecturer here, and the location inspired many elements of the story.

places.name: River Thames
places.connection: The story was first told by Lewis Carroll during a boat trip on the River Thames with Alice Liddell and her sisters.

places.name: Llandudno
places.connection: Alice Liddell, the inspiration for Alice, spent holidays here, and the town has several attractions dedicated to the story.

places.name: Guildford Castle
places.connection: Lewis Carroll spent time in Guildford, and the castle grounds are said to have inspired some elements of Wonderland.
